meta.note: Control sequences were produced by the deterministic pure-pursuit baseline, not by a trained PPO policy: the trained checkpoint (save/model.pt) is not distributed with this repository.

scenarios.name: corridor-turn
scenarios.description: Left-bending spline, random start pose; nominal tracking run.

scenarios.name: wide-sweep
scenarios.description: Mirrored control points produce a long right-hand sweep.

scenarios.name: tight-arc
scenarios.description: Short control-point spacing; the largest curvature of the set.

scenarios.name: offset-entry
scenarios.description: Start pose is offset from the path, so the controller must converge.

scenarios.name: biased-driver
scenarios.description: Steering bias of +-25 deg/s injected, so the run includes off-path segments.

scenarios.name: recovery
scenarios.description: Saturated turn for 30 steps, then baseline tracking; includes regressing steps.
scenarios.controller: saturated turn (60 deg/s) for 30 steps, then pure-pursuit
